segments.speaker: firstad
segments.caption: He means every line of the radio play, spoken. Telemachus is late. Odysseus, read in for him. Book sixteen, the swineherd's hut.

segments.speaker: odysseus
segments.caption: For news and enters the hut beside the unknown beggar?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.caption: The script for the back half was summaries. The voices read what they were given.

segments.speaker: examiner
segments.caption: On the thirtieth of July, two hundred and sixty-four lines were written for books sixteen to twenty-four. Seven hundred and six turns of seven hundred and six.

segments.speaker: firstad
segments.caption: Then the studio voices record them again.

segments.speaker: pa
segments.caption: You have reached your limit of one hundred requests today.

segments.speaker: firstad
segments.caption: Then in batches. One book at a time. At half the price.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.caption: A hundred and fifty-two scenes of a hundred and fifty-two.

segments.speaker: examiner
segments.caption: Not every line. Seven recordings in our own films still speak the summary, under the right caption.

segments.speaker: examiner
segments.caption: And the music: three albums. One takes its name, and twelve of its track names, word for word from the promptbook. Credited only to Treblo.
